source_caption_text:
Me and the homies when Tory Lanez starts performing “LUV” in 2075 😭🔥

How me and my homies gon be moving at a Tory Lanez concert when he gets out of jail in 2075. The second “LUV” comes on, everybody is going to know exactly what time it is. Released in 2016, the song had that perfect mid-2010s dancehall sound, with the catchy rhythm, smooth vocals, and feel-good energy that made it impossible to sit still.

“LUV” became one of Tory Lanez’s biggest songs from that era, blending his melodic style with a dancehall-inspired beat that instantly gets people moving. The hook is simple, catchy, and basically made for a crowd to yell back together. Even years later, those opening sounds are enough to bring back memories of summer parties, clubs, and late-night drives.

If “LUV” starts playing at that concert in 2075, you already know the whole section is going to turn up like no time has passed. Everybody is going to be dancing, yelling the hook, and acting like it’s 2016 all over again. Some songs just have that kind of staying power.

#torylanez #rap #meme
